name: simple-gif-cap
title: Simple GIF Cap
description: Record a region, window or screen straight to a GIF on your clipboard.
author: justsamuel

commands.name: record-region
commands.title: Record GIF of Region
commands.subtitle: Simple GIF Cap
commands.description: Drag a region, or press Space to pick a window. Run again to stop.

commands.name: record-window
commands.title: Record GIF of Window
commands.subtitle: Simple GIF Cap
commands.description: Hover and click the window to record. Run again to stop.

commands.name: record-screen
commands.title: Record GIF of Screen
commands.subtitle: Simple GIF Cap
commands.description: Record the display under the mouse. Run again to stop.

commands.name: stop-recording
commands.title: Stop GIF Recording
commands.subtitle: Simple GIF Cap
commands.description: Stop the running recording and open the preview.

commands.name: preview
commands.title: Show Last GIF
commands.subtitle: Simple GIF Cap
commands.description: Preview, trim, shrink and copy the latest GIF.

commands.name: recent-gifs
commands.title: Recent GIFs
commands.subtitle: Simple GIF Cap
commands.description: Browse, copy and edit your recent GIFs.

preferences.name: maxWidth
preferences.title: Max Width (px)
preferences.description: GIFs wider than this are scaled down.

preferences.name: encoder
preferences.title: Encoder
preferences.description: Built-in needs nothing installed. ffmpeg makes smaller files, gifski sharper ones (brew install ffmpeg gifski).

preferences.name: countdown
preferences.title: Countdown
preferences.description: Seconds to wait before recording starts.

preferences.name: maxDuration
preferences.title: Stop Automatically After
preferences.description: Stops long recordings before they get huge.

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: ffmpeg Path
preferences.description: Only needed for an ffmpeg outside Homebrew.
